summary.text: José F. Batista is a Democrat who has represented House District 12 in Providence (South Side and Washington Park) since being elected on November 3, 2020, and who serves on the Judiciary, Oversight, and Municipal Government and Housing committees.

paragraphs.text: According to his biography, Batista was born April 15, 1988, is a lifelong resident of South Providence and the oldest of six children of immigrants from the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico.

He attended Providence public schools, graduating from Classical High School in 2006, then Bryant University in 2011 and Roger Williams University School of Law in 2014, and has been an adjunct professor at Bryant since 2019 and at RWU Law since 2022.
He began his legal career at the Rhode Island Public Defender, opened a solo practice in South Providence in 2016, and formerly served as assistant city solicitor for Central Falls.

In the House he sponsored the law creating a statewide police body camera program and, in 2023, legislation making people on parole, probation or serving a suspended sentence eligible for jury service.
